_README: Control C0. This is the strategy that was the default when the evidence programme started. It is never replaced or edited: new variants are separate experiments with their own IDs, compared against C0. Changing any field here must change c0_hash, which the regression test pins.
name: slow-exit v4 (paper-trading candidate)

spec.name: slow-exit v4 (paper-trading candidate)
spec.entry_rule: Buy-stop at the signal-day high, valid for the next session only.
spec.exit_rule: Exit at the next open after a daily close below EMA50, or after 120 trading days.
spec.stop_rule: Hard stop = signal close - max(1.5 x ATR, 3% of close), fixed at entry.

signal_rule: stage==2 AND supertrend up AND scanner filters (RSI 33-80, price >= 0.95*EMA50, price >= 20) AND score >= 72
cost_model_for_reproduction: legacy flat: 15 bps costs + 10 bps slippage per side (settings.LEGACY_*); C0 is also reported under the itemised model
universe_for_reproduction: U159_v2 (current) and U160_legacy (original); results are never mixed across versions
